caption: The drawing depicts an open rectangular wooden box set against a plain beige background. The box is rendered in a reddish-brown wood tone with a hinged lid that is propped open. The inner surfaces of the box and lid are lined with a light green texture, with additional rectangular sections formed within the lining. The interior of the box is compartmentalized into six sections, with four long rectangular spaces in the center and two smaller squares in the top left and right corners, which appear to contain a grid pattern of reddish objects. The inner side of the lid has a rectangular frame, suggesting a mirror or a compartment, and two small reddish rectangles are also present within this area. There is a faint signature at the bottom right of the image reading “GÉO. V. VEZOLLES.”
title: Jewelry or Sewing Box
